# Computed example routes falsely qualify CSS for narrow E2E

## Context
PR #21800 narrowed Engine E2E for example CSS once the classifier finds a unique stylesheet owner and an Engine-tier browser witness. The merged code treats a computed path prefix as proof that a browser spec visits all apps under that prefix. [Observed on the merged change](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21800#issuecomment-7066689123)

## The Problem
At `5c8d14ab26`, the exact selector receives a modified record for `resources/css/src/examples/component/carousel/MainContainer.css`. It finds `examples/component/carousel/app.mjs` and credits `rendering/StoreLoadingNL.spec.mjs` as the only Engine-tier owner witness, yielding `full=false`. The spec visits `gallery` and `helix` only. Carousel's unit and component specs cannot qualify it for a narrower Engine E2E tier.

## The Architectural Reality
`e2eSpecReach.mjs` expands computed example prefixes for conservative reach. `e2eCiSelection.mjs` uses the same expanded entries to decide whether a stylesheet can narrow. Design authority comes from `#21796` AC-1 and the [approved ownership rule](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21725#discussioncomment-19795016): the owning app needs a browser spec that the Engine tier actually executes and that reaches that app.

## The Fix
Track evidence of concrete example-entry routes separately from conservative possible reach. Use the concrete evidence for stylesheet narrowing and keep the broader map for ordinary selection. Apply the existing full-tier fallback when the available evidence cannot establish a qualifying owner visit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The Carousel example stylesheet retains full Engine E2E coverage when the only apparent witness comes from the Gallery/Helix computed route. Run the exact selector before and after against this control.
- [ ] A real hosted browser spec with a concrete route to its unique stylesheet owner can still narrow, and the existing unnamed controls and mixed-Engine reach remain. Keep the existing full fallback for unknown ownership, external CSS consumers, moves and removals.
- [ ] Required check names, head association, and full selection for admitted `dev` pushes stay intact.

## Out of Scope
General dynamic path resolution and changes to test tier admission, runner groups, required contexts or `dev` push selection.
